summary: Iteration 12 — Regression sweep after Orb.jsx green-flash change (useOrbCanvas now takes a 5th flashRef arg; commitEnrollment briefly flashes orb GREEN for 1.8s and shows '✓ [name] remembered' after successful /speakers/enroll). Backend: 8/8 pytest green — GET /api/=200, POST /api/chat (anthropic, claude-sonnet-4-6, field 'message') returns 200 with non-empty reply, POST /api/voice/tts returns 200 audio/mpeg, all PWA root assets 200. Frontend: title 'Promethius', 0 console errors on both /install AND / (Orb) after JWT injection into localStorage 'promethius_token'. Orb canvas renders (1920x1080, cyan plasma visible in screenshot), all data-testids present (orb-canvas, orb-settings-button, orb-fullscreen-button, orb-open-chat-button, orb-logout-button, orb-status). Settings modal opens correctly on click (VoiceSettings tabs visible: Voice/Orb/Laws/People/Keys). Fullscreen button clickable without error. Code review of Orb.jsx confirms the flashRef wiring is correct: useOrbCanvas signature accepts flashRef (line 12), render() overrides r=34,g=211,b=120 when flashRef.current > Date.now() (line 34), flashRef useRef(0) declared (line 110), passed into useOrbCanvas (line 130), commitEnrollment sets flashRef.current = Date.now()+1800 and setMode('speaking', '✓ name remembered') on successful POST /api/speakers/enroll (lines 245-247). No regression. The user's ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED on localhost:8001 is a Windows-local hidden-boot process issue (not reproducible here) — served app is healthy.
critical_code_review_comments: Orb.jsx useOrbCanvas dependency array (line 92) does NOT include voiceRef or flashRef, only [canvasRef, energyRef, configRef]. In practice this is harmless because all four refs are stable useRef objects whose identity never changes — but for correctness/consistency the deps array should list all refs it reads. Non-blocking; the effect only mounts once anyway.

The green flash color (r=34, g=211, b=120) is hard-coded inline in useOrbCanvas rather than being surfaced as a constant (e.g., FLASH_COLOR_ENROLLED at top of file). Minor readability nit — non-blocking.

commitEnrollment (lines 238-254) swallows errors silently and still calls ask(utterance, name). This is intentional per the code comment ('enrollment failed — still respond') but the user gets no feedback that voiceprint save failed. Consider adding a toast.warning on the catch branch. Non-blocking.
All previous review items from iterations 5-11 remain resolved.

The Orb.jsx green-flash change did NOT break the module — verified: 0 console errors on both / and /install, orb renders, all controls present and clickable, backend 8/8 green.
